subject.title: fix: prevent silent message loss from EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError

question: Should OpenClaw accept PR #89039's contract of moving unconfigured SDK retries out of the embedded prompt-lock window, using one orchestrator retry for connection/timeout transport errors, and surfacing pure takeover as visible resend guidance?
rationale: The patch fixes a real message-loss bug, but the remaining choice is a compatibility-sensitive runtime policy decision about retry ownership, session-state recovery, and visible channel behavior rather than a mechanical code defect.

options.title: Accept PR contract after validation
options.body: Land this direction once exact merge-head CI is clean and maintainer review confirms the retry and resend semantics are intended.

options.title: Narrow the retry relocation
options.body: Keep visible takeover recovery but reduce or rework the SDK retry/default changes if maintainers do not want retry ownership to move to the orchestrator.

options.title: Choose queued replay instead
options.body: Pause or supersede this PR if maintainers want automatic queue/replay recovery rather than asking the user to resend after pure takeover.

recommendation.title: Accept PR contract after validation
recommendation.body: Land this direction once exact merge-head CI is clean and maintainer review confirms the retry and resend semantics are intended.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history makes Peter Steinberger the strongest available routing owner for the shared agent runtime, reply, and provider-transport surfaces involved in the policy decision.
